messages:
Carmen Vega: FYI incoming POC from Cobalt — want to confirm model fit + any enterprise blockers. Client needs med-length summarization + retrieval for internal docs, data residency in EU. timeline: 6 week POC. Can we onboard a custom variant of LlamaX-13B-quant?
Ravi Patel: Which variant exactly? int4 quant or FP16? Also what's the latency SLO?
Matt O'Neal: I chatted with Pall on the deal — they want sub-300ms median for 512 tokens. They'll pay for Dedicated if needed. Also they attached a security questionnaire.
Sofia Li: Security checklists: SOC2, DPA, BAA? They flagged KMS + audit logs as must-haves.
Carmen Vega: @Sofia I'll share the questionnaire. @Leon can we add LlamaX-13B-quant-int4 to our model catalog as a supported variant? Need quant profile + perf numbers.
Leon Kim: We can add it but need the model artifact + HF repo link + a quick compatibility test. Any custom ops? rotary embeddings? fused kernels?
Carmen Vega: Repo: https://hf.co/cobalt/llamax-13b-custom branch 'cobalt-q' — vendor says no custom ops, uses fused attention. I uploaded a sample config and weights pointer to the drive.
Ravi Patel: Quick checklist for compatibility: 1) kernel support scan 2) perf sweep across batch/seq 3) KV-cache correctness 4) confirm no external telemetry.
Sofia Li: They require EU data residency. For Hosted we can isolate region; for Dedicated/Private we can guarantee. Legal will need DPA + possibly a scoped BAA.
Carmen Vega: Pricing question from buyer: what's a ballpark for a 6-week Dedicated POC with 4 GPUs + eng support?
Matt O'Neal: Sales ballpark is $45k-$60k including some SE time. Ops: estimate infra ~ $10k/week but @Leon to confirm.
Leon Kim: Infra rough: with committed instances and minimal burst, estimate ~ $12k/week including infra + 1 ops engineer time for onboarding. I'll draft a quote and a rough SOW.
security-bot: New questionnaire uploaded: /shared/cobalt_security_qs/2026-05-14.pdf
Carmen Vega: We need a quick run of the compatibility tool. @Ravi can you run and paste results? Example:```ri-compat scan --model hf://cobalt/llamax-13b-custom --target triton --quant=int4```
deploy-bot: Model-compat-scan started for hf://cobalt/llamax-13b-custom at 1829000200
Ravi Patel: Running now, will post a short summary.
Ravi Patel: Scan complete — passed kernel checks on CUDA12 + Triton 23.08. Notes: fused-attn uses newer kernels so older Triton builds show a 2-3% perf fallback. KV-cache checks OK. No surprising ops. Attaching logs in thread.
Carmen Vega: That's acceptable. Action items: Leon to prepare catalog entry + perf numbers, Sofia to confirm legal + DPA draft, Matt to prepare pricing + SOW, Ravi to run perf sweep and post numbers. Timeline: get POC ready in 10 business days — @everyone, ok?
Sofia Li: I'll ping Legal. DPA draft 3-4 days, BAA review might add a week depending on their GC.
Matt O'Neal: Sales can target demo week of Jun 7. 10 business days aligns.
Carmen Vega: I'll set up a sync with Cobalt for tomorrow 09:00 CET and share invites. Thanks :thumbsup:
